laura: Quick heads-up — EU midnight change window in ~3h. We plan a staggered canary (10% -> 30% over 20m). Need quick confirmations on: pins, rollback triggers, who’s watching metrics, and smoke checks. Passing smoke = P95 < 800ms and errors <0.5% for rolling 5m. @deploy-bot can you post the scheduled config? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: start=2026-03-21T00:00:00+01:00 (EU-CET), steps=[10%,30%], step_duration=10m, total=20m. Canary pin: model=v3.2.1-quant, infra=dedicated-eu-1, grace_window=2m. Operators: laura,jamie,kelsey. Auto-rollback policy: enabled (thresholds set by sam).

```
{ 
  "canary": {
    "steps": [10, 30],
    "model": "v3.2.1-quant",
    "region": "eu",
    "auto_rollback": true
  }
}
```

jamie: Confirmed — I pinned traffic to v3.2.1-quant in the deploy config and pushed canary flag. No infra changes. :white_check_mark:

oren: I'll monitor embeddings and KV cache pressure. Alert set: embeddings-cost +30% => notify #eng-sre and paged to oren. Also watching Redis replication lag.

kelsey: Smoke tests ran in staging — all green. Command I ran: `./scripts/run-smoke.sh --suite quick` -> 0 failures. I'll be on the watch channel during the window. :eyes:

sam: Rollback criteria I added to the runbook: immediate pin-back to v3.2.0 if any of these persist for 3m: error_rate >= 0.5% OR P95 latency >= 1s. Manual rollback step also documented. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback-canary (ops access).

laura: Nice, thanks. Small ask — if deploy-bot reports any step failing, do not promote to 30% until we ack. Kelsey/sam/jamie please ack here when you’re ready.

kelsey: Ack — ready and monitoring.

jamie: Ack.

sam: Ack.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-21T00:00:00+01:00. Step=10% (0/20m). Will post step-complete messages. :rocket:

laura: Copy. Keeping channel pinned for the window. If anything deviates, call the rollback and @oncall-eng-sre. :phone:
